title: Format Lazy
statement: Implement `solve(enabled, message)`. `enabled` is 1 when DEBUG is on and 0 otherwise. Return the message only when enabled is 1. Return an empty string when debugging is off. Building the message is the caller's cost. Your job is to drop it when the level is disabled.
constraints: A disabled logger returns an empty string
hints: If enabled is 0, return an empty string without inventing a substitute.
Do not return the message in both cases.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Logging debug with an f-string builds the string even when the logger will throw it away.

editorial: Logging debug with an f-string builds the string even when the logger will throw it away. The guard is to ask the level first, or to pass a format and arguments the logger interpolates only if the record is emitted. This function is that guard: disabled means no message.
